name: agent-guardrails
description: Portable POSIX AST shell safety guard, $TMPDIR command/edit loop breakers, repository file-naming checks, and advisory subagent write-lock gates for Claude Code and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: AST shell guard, loop breaker, and write-lock gate
interface.longDescription: Inspects shell pipelines with a full POSIX AST parser, blocks destructive Git/SQL/DB/secret operations across selectable ecosystem presets (generic, laravel, symfony, wordpress, node, python, rust), breaks repeated command/edit loops via $TMPDIR counters, validates file naming, and serializes concurrent write-capable subagents.
defaultPrompt: Initialize guardrails policy for this repository preset.
Check whether this shell command is safe under guardrails policy.
Inspect current session loop counters and active guardrails rules.
